span.p:
POST /store/ { params } · POST /runs { programId or skillId, installDir?, frameworkContext?, config? }
the store shape on the wire: a route name is a FlowStore member name

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FlowStore.(…) · FlowStore.startRun(runSession)
the parent reaches exactly what the TUI can: the boundary list is the whitelist

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
runConfigFor({ ...program, ...config }) → runAgent(…, run.session, composed)
data fields lay over the program; functions in a run recipe never cross the wire

config; an unknown key or a wrong type is a 400
